name: Shishiou Nazuna
source:
When she isn't wearing a school uniform, she's always wearing a kimono. She's currently in fifth grade. Her yellow-green hair ornament is her most important and favorite thing. She always has a ball in her hand. She doesn't even know why she has it. By the way, it's super heavy.

Her strong point is that she is proactive and energetic. She is friendly, but will pursue any doubts until they are resolved. Her weak point is that she'll rush things if it can help her curiosity. At least that's what it says on her school transcript.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
